metadata.description: Number of Hyper-V WSFC clusters to create.
Number of Hyper-V nodes per cluster.
VM size for Hyper-V nodes. Must support nested virtualisation (D-series v3+).
VM size for domain controllers.
VM size for the relay host.
Active Directory domain FQDN.
AD NetBIOS domain name (max 15 chars).
Administrator username for all Windows VMs.
Administrator password. Must meet Azure complexity requirements.
Deploy a relay host (Ubuntu 22.04 + Docker).
Deploy domain controllers and configure Active Directory.
Deploy a jump box as the sole public-IP entry point into the lab.
VM size for the jump box.
OS image for Windows VMs.
VNet address space.
Management subnet prefix (DCs).
Base IP for cluster subnets. Cluster i uses 10.10.(baseOctet+i).0/24.
Services subnet prefix (relay).
DC1 private IP — sets VNet-level DNS so ALL VMs resolve via the domain controller. Leave empty for Azure-provided DNS.

settings.commandToExecute: [format('powershell -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -Command "Add-WindowsFeature AD-Domain-Services -IncludeManagementTools; Import-Module ADDSDeployment; Install-ADDSForest -DomainName ''{0}'' -DomainNetbiosName ''{1}'' -SafeModeAdministratorPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString ''{2}'' -AsPlainText -Force) -InstallDns -NoRebootOnCompletion:$false -Force"', parameters('domainName'), parameters('domainNetbios'), parameters('adminPassword'))]

[format('powershell -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -Command "Start-Sleep -Seconds 120; Add-WindowsFeature AD-Domain-Services -IncludeManagementTools; Import-Module ADDSDeployment; Install-ADDSDomainController -DomainName ''{0}'' -Credential (New-Object PSCredential(''{1}\{2}'',(ConvertTo-SecureString ''{3}'' -AsPlainText -Force))) -SafeModeAdministratorPassword (ConvertTo-SecureString ''{4}'' -AsPlainText -Force) -InstallDns -NoRebootOnCompletion:$false -Force"', parameters('domainName'), parameters('domainNetbios'), parameters('adminUsername'), parameters('adminPassword'), parameters('adminPassword'))]

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -Command "reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard /v EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f; reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard /v RequirePlatformSecurityFeatures /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f; DISM /Online /Enable-Feature /FeatureName:Microsoft-Hyper-V-All /All /NoRestart; DISM /Online /Enable-Feature /FeatureName:FailoverCluster-Core /All /NoRestart; shutdown /r /t 30"

resources.name: [format('{0}/{1}', format('vm-hv-{0}-{1}', variables('clusterName'), padLeft(range(0, parameters('nodeCount'))[range(0, parameters('nodeCount'))[copyIndex()]], 2, '0')), 'PreDomainJoin')]

settings.commandToExecute: [format('powershell -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -Command "Start-Sleep 90; Stop-Service dnscache -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service dnscache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep 10; ipconfig /flushdns | Out-Null; $dc = ''{0}''; $attempts = 0; while ($attempts -lt 30) {{ if (Test-NetConnection -ComputerName $dc -Port 389 -InformationLevel Quiet -WarningAction SilentlyContinue) {{ break }}; Start-Sleep 15; $attempts++ }}; Write-Output ''DC reachable — proceeding to domain join''"', parameters('dc1Ip'))]

dependsOn: [resourceId('Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/extensions', format('vm-hv-{0}-{1}', variables('clusterName'), padLeft(range(0, parameters('nodeCount'))[range(0, parameters('nodeCount'))[range(0, parameters('nodeCount'))[copyIndex()]]], 2, '0')), 'InstallHyperV')]

resources.name: [format('{0}/{1}', format('vm-hv-{0}-{1}', variables('clusterName'), padLeft(range(0, parameters('nodeCount'))[range(0, parameters('nodeCount'))[copyIndex()]], 2, '0')), 'DomainJoin')]

settings.commandToExecute: [format('powershell -ExecutionPolicy Unrestricted -Command "Install-WindowsFeature RSAT-Clustering -IncludeManagementTools; $nodes = {0}; New-Cluster -Name {1} -Node $nodes -StaticAddress {2} -NoStorage -Force"', variables('nodeListPs'), variables('clusterName'), variables('clusterIp'))]

settings.script:
[base64(format('#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update -y || apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg
install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg
echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(lsb_release -cs) stable" | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin
systemctl enable docker
systemctl start docker
usermod -aG docker {0}
echo "DOCKER_READY" >> /var/log/cloudgrange-lab.log
', parameters('adminUsername')))]

Stop-Service dnscache -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service dnscache -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep 10; ipconfig /flushdns | Out-Null; Set-ItemProperty -Path ''HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server'' -Name fDenyTSConnections -Value 0 -Force; Enable-NetFirewallRule -DisplayGroup ''Remote Desktop''; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path ''C:\Users\{2}\Desktop'' | Out-Null; Set-Content -Path ''C:\Users\{3}\Desktop\CloudGrange-Lab.txt'' -Value (''CloudGrange Lab Environment'',''=========================='',''Domain   : cloudgrange.lab'',''NetBIOS  : CLOUDGRANGE'',''Username : {4}'',''Password : {5}'','''',''SERVERS'',''-------'',''vm-jumpbox   10.10.0.4    Jump box (public IP: use RDP from internet)'',''vm-dc01      10.10.0.10   Primary Domain Controller - AD DS forest'',''vm-dc02      10.10.0.11   Secondary Domain Controller'',''vm-hv-c0-n00 10.10.1.10   Hyper-V Cluster 0 Node 0'',''vm-hv-c0-n01 10.10.1.11   Hyper-V Cluster 0 Node 1'',''vm-hv-c1-n00 10.10.2.10   Hyper-V Cluster 1 Node 0'',''vm-hv-c1-n01 10.10.2.11   Hyper-V Cluster 1 Node 1'',''vm-relay-01  {6}  CloudGrange Relay (Ubuntu 22.04 Docker CE)'','''',''ACCESS'',''------'',''From this jump box RDP/SSH to any server by private IP.'',''All Windows VMs: mstsc /v:<ip>  ->  {7} / {8}'',''Relay (SSH): ssh {9}@{10}'','''',''CLUSTER INFO'',''------------'',''Cluster 0 IP  : 10.10.1.5  (Windows Server Failover Cluster)'',''Cluster 1 IP  : 10.10.2.5  (Windows Server Failover Cluster)'')"', parameters('dc1Ip'), parameters('dc1Ip'), parameters('adminUsername'), parameters('adminUsername'), parameters('adminUsername'), parameters('adminPassword'), parameters('relayIp'), parameters('adminUsername'), parameters('adminPassword'), parameters('adminUsername'), parameters('relayIp'))]
